overview: This Senate resolution congratulates The Ohio State University Buckeyes on winning the 2025 College Football Playoff National Championship, the first title decided under the new 12-team playoff format. Ohio State beat Notre Dame 34 to 23 on January 20, 2025, finishing the season 14-2 and earning the school its ninth national football championship. The resolution praises the players, coaches, staff, and fans, and asks that official copies be sent to the university's president, athletic director, and head coach. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on January 30, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution honors a major achievement by student athletes and a public university that many Ohioans take pride in.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
